reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that tracks agent and session activity, unlocks persistent achievements, and presents progress through galleries, dashboards, toasts, and sidebar UI.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 记录智能体与会话活动、解锁成就并通过画廊、仪表盘和通知界面展示进度。
summaries.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness agent and session activity, unlocks persistent achievements, and displays progress through galleries, dashboards, and notifications.

capabilities: 监听 agent 和 session 事件元数据
统计工具调用、文件操作、子代理、workflow、goal 和 preset 等行为
将成就进度持久化到本地 JSON
提供成就画廊、仪表盘、toast、侧栏奖杯和输入坞进度界面
可选读取消息正文并扫描历史会话以解锁成就
可选向配置的遥测端点上传成就标识、稀有度和匿名安装标识
